reasons: 90% start-time interval is 22.3 h wide (limit 6 h)
spread-rate scale is at the model's ceiling: the modeled wind and fuels cannot grow the observed footprints fast enough, so start time and spread rate trade off

model_card: Elliptical rate-of-spread model with per-fuel base rates (ESA WorldCover classes), power-law wind and tan²-slope terms, HRRR 3 km wind field interpolated per cell; no spotting, crown fire or suppression. Relative posterior over evaluated candidates, tau = 9.6 h (calibrated on this fire's synthetic cases).
